_comment: Central local resource catalogue for the web and desktop bundles.
A package is available in a build only when its required files are present and verified.
The mouse uses a declared synthetic visual-to-action convention; MICrONS has no motor cortex.

species.name: Fruit fly
species.redistribute_why: FlyWire is CC BY-NC 4.0: redistributable with attribution, NON-COMMERCIAL only. This is what Open Fly's public page already does.
species.public_why: CC BY-NC 4.0 allows redistribution only for non-commercial purposes; this public build has no non-commercial-use restriction.

species.name: Fruit fly
species.coverage: brain, optic lobes, neck connective and ventral nerve cord
species.note: the sign problem is already solved here, and the licence is the most permissive on the roster
species.redistribute_why: MaleCNS v1.0 is CC-BY 4.0: redistributable with attribution
species.public_why: CC BY 4.0; retain attribution to MaleCNS v1.0 and its authors.

species.name: Fruit fly
species.redistribute_why: Winding et al. 2023 supplementary data states no licence
species.public_why: No explicit data redistribution licence was found.
species.warning: its senses are wired on OUR convention, not the source's: the larva's sensory neurons are assumed cholinergic because only 243 of 2,952 neurons have a published transmitter. 88% of its connections are still dropped as unsigned.

species.name: Roundworm
species.note: gap junctions are not chemical synapses; a LIF core that treats them alike is wrong invisibly
species.redistribute_why: Cook et al. 2019 / WormWiring state no open licence (Copyright Emmons Lab)
species.public_why: WormWiring states Emmons Lab copyright; no public redistribution licence was found.

species.name: Roundworm
species.redistribute_why: Cook et al. 2019 / WormWiring state no open licence (Copyright Emmons Lab)
species.public_why: WormWiring states Emmons Lab copyright; no public redistribution licence was found.

species.name: Sea squirt
species.note: 1,206 gap junctions against 6,618 chemical synapses: a fifth of the wiring is electrical, and a LIF core that ignores that is wrong silently
species.redistribute_why: eLife 16962 source data is CC-BY 4.0: redistributable with attribution
species.public_why: CC BY 4.0; retain attribution to Ryan et al. (2016), eLife 5:e16962.

species.name: Zebrafish
species.note: vglut2a and gad1b labels give each cell a sign, which is what makes a LIF model possible at all
species.redistribute_why: Fish1 data policy (read 2026-09-21, fish1-release.storage.googleapis.com/data_policy.html): an 'Open Access Policy' whose condition is that any work using it cites Petkova et al. 2025; it names no licence and says nothing about derived data, and is shipped on the owner's decision, with that citation
species.public_why: The policy requires citation but does not explicitly grant redistribution of the dataset files.
species.warning: This fish senses through four brain nuclei chosen by our convention, because its peripheral sense organs are missing from the traced data.

species.name: Mouse
species.functional: ~75,000 pyramidal neurons with recorded responses to visual stimuli
species.redistribute_why: MICrONS source data is CC BY 4.0, but the released digital-twin model weights state no licence; included only in the owner’s local build.
species.public_why: The downloaded MICrONS digital-twin model weights have no explicit redistribution licence.
species.note: MICrONS is visual cortex only. The game maps visual-model activity to actions by a deterministic synthetic readout; this is not biological motor output.
